For 1 monitor shared between 2 computers, I recommend a 2-port HDMI or DisplayPort KVM switch. It lets you use one monitor, keyboard, and mouse with two computers and switch between them with a button.

The best choice depends mainly on your monitor's resolution and refresh rate, and whether your computers use HDMI, DisplayPort, or USB-C.
